AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Homemade Sun Dryer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Animal Feed: Hay and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Leftover Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Integrated Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Organic Gardening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
